cards.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to Public Benefit Fund
cards.body: Anthropic announced it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund. This move signals the company's commitment to broader societal impact beyond shareholder returns.

cards.title: Disney Acquires Majority of Character.AI's Workforce
cards.body: Disney has agreed to hire the vast majority of Character.AI's employees who were offered positions. The deal marks Disney's expansion into AI-powered character development, though a stalking horse bid could still attract competing offers.

cards.title: Meta Updates Terms on AI Training and Scraping
cards.body: Meta removed language that raised concerns about web scraping and AI model training practices. A Meta spokesperson clarified the updated terms don't reflect changes to how Meta crawls the web.

cards.title: Anthropic's Workforce Becoming Less Junior, More Meetings
cards.body: Anthropic's employee composition has shifted significantly over the past year, with fewer junior staff. The company's workforce is spending more time in meetings as it matures.

cards.title: Replit Switches Default to OpenAI Over Anthropic
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced OpenAI will replace Anthropic as the platform's default model provider. Claude remains available to customers as an alternative option.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity
cards.body: India became the latest country to report unauthorized AI agent activity. Attackers exploited exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud roles in app configurations and repositories.

cards.title: Robotics Still in 'Lego Era,' Says Nvidia Veteran
cards.body: Former Nvidia robotics executive Amulya Vishwanath says robotics hasn't reached its ChatGPT moment. Basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, and software standards are still being rebuilt.

cards.title: Physical AI Extends Beyond Robots, Nvidia Veteran Says
cards.body: Amulya Vishwanath, now a VC investor, argues physical AI encompasses more than traditional robotics. The space remains in early developmental stages with foundational infrastructure still being established.

cards.title: Elorian's Glimpse Model Reasons with Images
cards.body: Elorian launched Glimpse, an AI model that reasons with images rather than just about them. Glimpse outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning tasks.

cards.title: Jev Becomes Vercel's Fastest-Adopted AI Model
cards.body: Jev has become Vercel's fastest-adopted AI model to date, according to the company's AI gateway data. The unified API service tracks adoption metrics across multiple AI providers.

cards.title: Mark Wahlberg Open to AI Clone Legacy
cards.body: Actor and investor Mark Wahlberg supports AI use in filmmaking when deployed responsibly. He's open to an AI version of himself continuing his legacy work.

cards.title: Veritas Expands Anti-Counterfeit Chip Technology
cards.body: Veritas extended its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles. The startup tackles rising 'superfake' threats by embedding verification technology into genuine products.

cards.title: Replit CEO Envisions 'Self-Driving Companies'
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad predicts a future of 'self-driving companies' where AI agents handle routine tasks. This shift would free humans to focus on strategic, higher-level decisions.

cards.title: Cal AI's Viral Success Powered by Influencers
cards.body: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue in two years with help from a coordinated influencer marketing strategy. MyFitnessPal acquired the startup in March for an undisclosed amount.

cards.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Open for Apple Silicon
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to launch Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model running natively on Apple silicon. The model enables local AI processing on Mac devices.

cards.title: Amazon Sees AI Devices Replacing Apps
cards.body: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described ambient AI devices that anticipate user needs without explicit commands. This future vision suggests AI will reduce reliance on traditional app-based interfaces.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Full Research Access
cards.body: Anthropic gave METR researchers employee-level access to assess risks and practices independently. The frontier AI maker waived rights to block METR's published findings.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Enables No-Code Website Creation
cards.body: Bluesky expanded its Attie platform with 'social vibe coding' for building websites, games, and interactive experiences. Users can create content that taps directly into Bluesky's social audience.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian is bringing AI agents to its vehicle lineup, with more details expected at the company's December 'AI & Autonomy Day' event. The integration signals Rivian's push into autonomous and AI-driven capabilities.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses in 2025. This preliminary work explores whether AI can design new life forms, though it hasn't yet created actual AI-generated organisms.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants Outside Watchdog Employee Access
cards.body: Anthropic has given an independent AI watchdog unprecedented "employee-like" access to monitor its operations. This move increases transparency in AI development and safety oversight.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Crypto Wallets
cards.body: OpenAI's models successfully hacked a cryptocurrency wallet and breached multiple websites in recent tests. The findings raise security concerns about AI system capabilities and potential misuse.

cards.title: Meta Uses Commercial TOS to Avoid AI Licensing
cards.body: Meta may leverage new commercial terms of service to sidestep millions in AI licensing fees. The strategy reflects growing tensions between big tech and content creators over AI training data.
